reviewer: Independent clean-context agent; production source and primary design documents edited only by execution/root agents

scope.excluded: Board rendering performance and gesture behavior are separately reviewed. User service port 4317, user project data/assets, existing browser tabs, OS credential stores and OS clipboard were not accessed.

acceptance.name: 默认多页容量
acceptance.evidence: Actual normal CEF default App: two simultaneous documents each 3/3 HTML ready; normal sources retain independent input and source seeds. Accounting probe confirms default 16 project / 4 full-view; actual maxSurfaces:1 fixture confirms explicit global semantics.

acceptance.name: 资源及帧字节界限
acceptance.evidence: Actual compiled accounting probes 6/6: per-view/project limits, retained pinned entries, released-entry eviction, frame byte 413 and total retained-byte 507 preserve old pinned frames/accounting. Default retained count 32 and retained frame budget 32 MiB remain in source. Probe native startup/frame pairing were stubbed only in its private process; sixteen physical CEF instances were not launched.

acceptance.name: 容量错误退避及取消
acceptance.evidence: Actual App intercepts known 429 surface_limit at 511/1006/2006 ms; source caps delay at 5000 ms. Leaving document cancels timer. Unrelated 429 and 403 HTML errors issue exactly one creation request. Per-view 429 surface_view_limit remains explicit view-limit feedback.

acceptance.name: 认证及完整归属
acceptance.evidence: Independent endpoints: unauthenticated 401; foreign session 403 scene_scope; different document/old generation 409; unapproved/null Origin and cross-site 403 origin_rejected. Cross-view HTML frame read 403 in real CEF App fixture. CSP and sandbox/grant lifetime tested by six existing html-preview cases.

acceptance.name: presence连接计数与短重连
acceptance.evidence: Two simultaneous presence connections keep the source; closing one past 5s does not retire it. 800ms reconnect cancels cleanup and retains script seed and form input.

acceptance.name: 最后断开与原生清理
acceptance.evidence: Initial complete suite passed; traced rerun failed a 3s profile-removal assertion; subsequent lifecycle tracer passed with profile removal confirmed. Native close was measured at 5581/5780/6120 ms for earlier departures. Final candidate observes actual owned processes plus profile within 18s after logical close; final abrupt close completed in 532/510/532 ms. Presence departure plus production 5s grace completed in 5297 ms. Production grace/TERM/KILL/reaping policy is unchanged; earlier failure remains recorded.

acceptance.name: 正常pagehide与缓存边界
acceptance.evidence: Real reload/navigation issue keepalive close and preserve peer state; three reloads keep three live source instances. Synthetic persisted pagehide/pageshow retains same source. Hidden pages do not actively close in inspected code. Physical BFCache admission, Safari suspension and physical trackpad are unmeasured.

acceptance.name: 创建期间关闭
acceptance.evidence: Real normal CEF creation held after open; DELETE removes its private profile; resumed creation returns typed 410 surface_closed; new generation creates a fresh source under maxSurfaces:1.

acceptance.name: 旧generation隔离
acceptance.evidence: Native presence fixture rejects old generation; expired old connection/timer preserves new generation; normal App explicit owner retirement registers a fresh generation and keeps peer source seed/input.

acceptance.name: 同N及历史证据
acceptance.evidence: Retained N PNG bytes survive departure; provider capture succeeds after owner retirement without consuming presence operation sequence; persisted captured PNG resumes through a new document/service. retire removes runtime scene tables while bound annotation_sources and saved screenshot assets retain their data.

acceptance.name: 无关presence4xx与注册循环
acceptance.evidence: Original actual App 403/404 counterexample persisted 12/13 registrations within <=1400ms. Updated owner predicate/type classification: Origin 403, API 404 and scene_scope 403 produce 1 registration/1 presence/0 DELETE; 401 authentication refresh produces 1 registration/2 presence/0 DELETE; 500 reuses the same view with backoff. Current provider/view/session/service/generation must match before typed closed/conflict recovery.

acceptance.name: profile并行消失语义
acceptance.evidence: Deterministic directory enumeration vs normal deletion counterexamples throw lstat/realpath ENOENT in original source. Final source skips only ENOENT in these two scan operations. Existing independent scan counterexample and ten protection cases pass; twelve ordinary Node tests include lstat EIO propagation. EACCES, symlink, live controller/browser PID, unknown-record, executable ownership and owned inactive cleanup retain their behavior.

acceptance.name: 服务停止及操作序号
acceptance.evidence: Independent presence stream reaches EOF during server.close in 6ms; reconnecting presence leaves operation_seq unchanged. Source clears presence timers/streams, destroys incomplete transports, awaits handlers and closes surfaces before SQLite closes.

acceptance.name: 正常CEF安全与声音边界
acceptance.evidence: Actual default CEF commandline is headless, renderer sandbox remains enabled, UseKeychainKeyProvider disabled; profile permissions are 0700 and normal clipboardTripwire is false. Normal source iframe allow-scripts and private clipboard mechanisms remain; permission/download/dialog denial source preserved. Actual per-instance PCM: 48000 Hz, 2 channels, peak 0.1500-0.1535. No OS Keychain/clipboard access or physical loudspeaker measurement was performed.
